EmailTemplate.name: Maintenance Troubleshooting / Possible Service Fee Electrical
EmailTemplate.subject: Maintenance Troubleshooting / Possible Service Fee
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
You have submitted a work order in regard to some ELECTRICAL issues. We are dispatching a vendor to the property to assess and fix any problem.
Please be sure that you have:
Checked the breakers to ensure they haven't tripped into the OFF position; Checked for lightbulbs that need to be changed; and Checked that outlets are not overloaded.
If the vendor comes and the problem is related to any of the listed items, a service charge will be applied to your account .
Please be expecting a call from the vendor. You likely will not recognize their phone number, so make sure you answer any unknown calls please.
